items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I think that also a part of this story might come from Lanigan

ctx.x: No, they were in school together, though. Now, my partner can give you this accurately. My opinion is that their families selected the instrument they were going to play. I don't think Bud picked up the tenor. And I don't think, I'm quite sure Jimmy didn't get a clarinet. I mean a cornet.

Yes. I think that also a part of this story might come from Lanigan, who being a little there senior and wanting to organize a band may have influenced them what instrument to get. Was it Jimmy McPartland's father who had the music store? He had something to do, didn't he, with getting instruments for them? Was he a teacher? He may have been a teacher.
I should know that and I don't remember.
